label: 01 · Line 3 – Traceability Records
info:
Line 3 builds electric water pump assemblies (EWP-2201-A / -B) through four stations:

OP10 Rotor press (press force, kN)
OP20 Housing torque (Nm)
OP30 Leak test (sccm)
OP40 End-of-line performance (flow, l/min)

Every station event becomes ONE standardised traceability record in FlowFuse Tables:
who (operator, shift), what (serial, part, work order), how (measurement vs. spec),
with what (material lot -> supplier heat number & cert), measured by what (gauge + cal due date).

That single record shape is what makes audit evidence a query instead of a project
(IATF 16949: 8.5.2 identification & traceability, 7.1.5 measurement traceability, 10.2 nonconformity).

The simulator stands in for your real line - swap it for OPC UA / Modbus / MQTT / REST
nodes and keep everything downstream unchanged.

label: 03 · Audit Evidence MCP Server
info:
Line 3 Audit Evidence MCP Server
================================

Requires:
- FlowFuse Enterprise instance (same instance as the Line 3 traceability flow,
  so the Tables query nodes hit the same database)
- Palette package: @flowfuse-nodes/nr-mcp-server-nodes
- @flowfuse/nr-tables-nodes (pre-installed on FlowFuse Cloud)

Connect a client
----------------
The server listens at:  <instance-url>/mcp   (http/sse)

Secure it first: Instance Settings -> Security -> FlowFuse User Authentication,
then create a token and connect with:

{
  "line3-audit-evidence": {
    "url": "https://<instance>.flowfuse.cloud/mcp",
    "type": "http",
    "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer ffhttp_xxxxxxxx" }
  }
}

Or skip external clients entirely: FlowFuse Expert discovers this server from
the Insights tab and can call every tool from chat.

IMPORTANT: open each MCP Tool node and tick the "Read-Only Hint" annotation.
All five tools only read data; the annotation lets Viewers use them under
FlowFuse RBAC. (Annotations are set in the node's edit dialog.)

Questions this server answers
-----------------------------
- "Pull the full genealogy for serial EWP2201A-260714-00123"
- "Topline audit stats for the last 7 days"
- "Any open leak-test nonconformances this week?"
- "Which units contain material lot LOT-B-2211, and did any fail?"
- "Show FPY by part and day for the last 14 days"

Topline audit stats (24 h)
query:
-- Topline audit stats, last 24 hours
WITH started AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT serial_number FROM process_events
  WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours' AND station = 'OP10'
),
failed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT serial_number FROM process_events
  WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours' AND result = 'FAIL'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM started) AS units_started_24h,
  round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM started s
                 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM failed f WHERE f.serial_number = s.serial_number))
        / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM started), 0), 1) AS fpy_pct,
  (SELECT round(1000000.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'FAIL') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 0)
     FROM process_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours') AS defect_ppm_ops,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM quality_events WHERE status = 'open') AS open_ncs,
  (SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE material_lot IS NOT NULL
                                           AND gauge_id IS NOT NULL
                                           AND operator_id IS NOT NULL)
        / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1)
     FROM process_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours') AS trace_coverage_pct,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT gauge_id) FROM process_events
    WHERE gauge_cal_due < CURRENT_DATE + 30) AS gauges_cal_due_30d;

name: FPY per hour (24 h)
query:
-- First pass yield per hour, last 24 hours
WITH s AS (
  SELECT serial_number, date_trunc('hour', min(ts)) AS hr
  FROM process_events
  WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
  GROUP BY serial_number
),
f AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT serial_number FROM process_events
  WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours' AND result = 'FAIL'
)
SELECT extract(epoch FROM s.hr) * 1000 AS x,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.serial_number IS NULL) / count(*), 1) AS y
FROM s
LEFT JOIN f ON f.serial_number = s.serial_number
GROUP BY s.hr
ORDER BY s.hr;

title: Audit Readiness Briefing
description: Guides the AI through a full audit-prep pass: topline stats, open NCs, FPY dips and spot-check unit traces, ending with likely auditor probes and the evidence for each.
template:
You are helping prepare evidence for an IATF 16949 audit of Line 3 (EWP-2201 electric water pump assembly).

Produce an audit-readiness briefing for the last {{ period }}:

1. Call get_topline_audit_stats and report units started, first pass yield, defect PPM, open nonconformances, traceability coverage and gauges due calibration within 30 days.
2. Call search_nonconformances (status: open) and summarise the open NCs by station and defect code, flagging anything without a disposition.
3. Call get_fpy_by_part_and_day and note any day/part combination where FPY dropped below {{ fpy_threshold }} percent.
4. For any failed units that stand out, call get_unit_trace and check the genealogy is complete (material lot, heat number, gauge calibration all present).

Finish with a short list of items a lead auditor is likely to probe, and the evidence already available for each. Keep the tone factual - no speculation beyond the data returned.
